title: groups/<group>.json
description: What every row of a position group shares per metric, in registry metric order (the index matches a player file's metrics array).

defending_note.description: The sentence shown with a withheld Defending score (ADR 004 §14 N2 / N3).

family_definitions.description: Family -> one plain line on what the family score measures (scored families only; withheld families show their reason). Checked against the score's members at export.

unit.description: Shown next to the value: "per 90", "per shot", or empty when the value text carries it (%).

definition.description: One plain sentence from the metric's implementation (checked by the stats-reviewer).

gap_eligible.description: May headline compare mode's top-6 gap list (user, 2026-10-09, option c): not a signature trait, not associated with team possession, not long pass completion. The site also needs a percentile on both rows.

notes.description: Notes and display reasons, each short text once; full texts joined for the popover.

withheld_tag.description: "(<Family> score withheld: <reason>)" when the metric's family score is withheld in this group.
